description.value:
When imbibed, the herbal wine created by this enchanted, golden goblet aids in spells and rituals designed to transfer memories, though sometimes at a steep price. Any liquid created by the goblet evaporates if not consumed within 1 minute.

Activate—Awaken Ancestral Memory 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect The goblet fills with a foul-tasting but potent herbal wine. When used as a part of the cost of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Recall Past Life] ritual, the wine grants a +3 item bonus to skill checks made to cast the ritual. After the ritual is complete, the next time each caster (but not the imbiber) falls asleep, they must attempt a @Check[will|dc:34] save against the effects of the nightmare spell, as Yig sends horrific visions of writhing serpents to disturb their slumber. A creature that fails the saving throw must repeat the save each night until they succeed.

Activate—Share Memory 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You think of a particular memory, which the goblet transforms into a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Potion of Shared Memories]. A creature that drinks this potion gains a +1 item bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Recall Knowledge] in a skill of your choice in which you're trained. If you're expert in the skill, the item bonus increases to +2. If you're master, the bonus increases to +3, and if you're legendary, the bonus increases to +4. This bonus lasts for 1 hour.

Activate—Drink and Hiss 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You drink from the goblet, imbuing your breath with Yig's omens, and then exhale. All creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] must make a @Check[fortitude|dc:34|options:area-effect] save against the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Mindfog Mist]. A creature that doesn't worship Yig takes @Damage[3d6[persistent,mental]|options:area-damage] damage for as long as they remain poisoned by this effect.

Destruction If a creature holding the Venom of Memories is swallowed whole by Yig or one of his divine servants, the goblet melts and is destroyed.
